blocks.title: Pathfinder {{model}} Cutting System
blocks.body:
Model {{model}} conveyorised computer controlled cutting system. Maximum compressed cutting height {{cutHeightCm}}cm. Maximum cutting width {{cutWidthCm}}cm.

- Conveyorised precision cutting table
- High efficiency vacuum generator
- Vacuum VSD (Variable Speed Device) - computer controlled vacuum level for optimising cut quality and reducing power consumption.
- VRB (Vacuum Recovery Blind) - computer controlled blind that reduces vacuum loss and power consumption.
- Unloading conveyor
- Roll holder (used for plastic overlay)
- Operator console with utility drawer
- Touch screen with wireless keyboard and mouse

### Software

- Windows 10™ operating system
- PathCut™ cutting software V12.x (graphic user interface)

### Accessories

- Operator manual
- Operator tool kit
- 1 roll plastic overlay
- 1 roll perforated paper
- 10 knives
- 1 diamond sharpening stone

**Price: {{price}}**

blocks.title: OFD — Offload Display
blocks.body: **OFD (Offload Display)** – additional LCD mounted above offloading table assists bundling operation.

blocks.title: OFP — Offload Printer
blocks.body: **OFP (Offload Printer)** – automatic printing of piece identification.

blocks.title: MTS — Machine Transfer System
blocks.body: **MTS (Machine Transfer System)** – enables the machine to travel laterally on tracks to service multiple lay up tables. Machine travel distance of {{metres}} metres servicing {{tables}} tables.

blocks.title: IKA — IceKnife Air
blocks.body: **IKA (IceKnife™ Air)** – knife cooling system minimises fusing of plies.

blocks.title: DRG — Drag Knife
blocks.body: **DRG (Drag Knife)** – drag knife assembly (interchangeable with reciprocating foot assembly). Utilises a standard 'snap-off' utility blade. This option is ideal for cutting various materials including prepreg composites and plastics.

blocks.title: PM — Pattern Match
blocks.body: **PM (Pattern Match)** – for matching materials with checks, stripes or motifs.

blocks.title: APM — Adaptive Pattern Matching
blocks.body: **APM (Adaptive Pattern Matching)** – pattern matching stripes and motifs. Includes various modes of pattern matching from traditional piece skew placement and shape transformation.

blocks.title: HDC — HeadCam
blocks.body: **HDC (HeadCam™)** – interactive camera visual display enhancing PathCut™ operational features.

blocks.title: PRM — Production Manager
blocks.body: **PRM (Production Manager)** – integrated productivity, operational and consumable reporting.

blocks.title: PRA — Production Analyst
blocks.body: **PRA (Production Analyst)** – standalone software module for machine(s) productivity, operational and consumable reporting.

blocks.title: BCR — Barcode Scanner
blocks.body: **BCR (Barcode Scanner)** – data input.

blocks.title: MRK — Marking Tool
blocks.body: **MRK (Marking Tool)** – pneumatically activated suitable for use with typical marking tools such as BIC biro and similar.

blocks.title: ABR — Air Brush
blocks.body: **ABR (Air Brush)** – air brush marking tool. Fixed adjustable height air brush including ink/paint reservoir.

blocks.title: DR2 — Secondary Drill
blocks.body: **DR2 (Secondary Drill)** – secondary drill.

blocks.title: HFV — High Flow Vacuum
blocks.body: **HFV (High Flow Vacuum)** – designed to maximise vacuum in applications where lofty materials are used.

blocks.title: RSP — Remote Support Program
blocks.body: **RSP (Remote Support Program)** – 12 months remote support program. Direct factory phone support as described in attached document.

blocks.title: AFP — Automatic Foot Pressure
blocks.body: **AFP (Automatic Foot Pressure)** – 2 pressure settings preset by pressure regulators. Accessible by preset parameters.

blocks.title: PathWorks (I) — Integrated Software
blocks.body:
Integrated software module within PathCut™. PathWorks features include pattern creation tools, digitising using the Pathfinder cutter controls, magnetic nesting (manual), pattern shredding, and importing/exporting of standard DXF, HPGL and G-code.

**Options:**
- WPN – Panel Wizard
- WPN – Pool Wizard
- PDG – PhotoDigitizer
- ANT – Automatic Nesting

blocks.title: PathWorks (S) — Standalone Software
blocks.body:
Standalone software. PathWorks features include pattern creation tools, magnetic nesting (manual), pattern shredding, and importing/exporting of standard DXF, HPGL and G-code. The software can be installed on a standard computer running Windows.

**Options:**
- WPN – Panel Wizard
- WPN – Pool Wizard
- PDG – PhotoDigitizer
- ANT – Automatic Nesting

blocks.title: WPN — Panel Wizard
blocks.body: **WPN – Panel Wizard** – PathWorks software option.

blocks.title: WPN — Pool Wizard
blocks.body: **WPN – Pool Wizard** – PathWorks software option.

blocks.title: PDG — PhotoDigitizer
blocks.body: **PDG – PhotoDigitizer** – PathWorks software option.

blocks.title: ANT — Automatic Nesting
blocks.body: **ANT – Automatic Nesting** – PathWorks software option.

blocks.title: Fabric Master (FM-{{model}})
blocks.body:
The semi-automatic Fabric Master is designed to spread fabric efficiently with a single operator. Existing tables can be utilised, reducing implementation time and cost.

**System consists of the following:**
- Electronic selvage control
- Automatic cutter
- Automatic knife sharpener
- LCD display
- Ply counter ('face to face' or 'face up')
- Fixed fabric catcher

blocks.title: Fabric Pro (FP-{{model}})
blocks.body:
The Fabric Pro is a fully automatic spreading machine designed to spread fabric efficiently with a single operator (suitable table at 220mm wider than the rated maximum spreading width is required).

**System consists of the following:**
- Electronic selvage control
- Automatic cross cutter
- Touch screen operator interface
- Material cradle for roll weights up to 120kg. Roll diameter up to 450mm.
- 1 x moving fabric catcher (included only when a special table is used to accommodate the moving catcher)

blocks.title: Spreading Table — Modular
blocks.body:
Frame is constructed from steel with integrated side rails to suit standard Fabric Master Spreader.

- 2m table width
- 1.2m sections (white laminate table top)
- Total {{totalLengthM}}m length

Quantity: {{tableQty}}

blocks.title: Easy-Loader #1
blocks.body:
Conveyorised Spreading Table ({{lengthM}}mtr)

The Easy-Loader is designed to integrate with the Pathfinder cutting system, automatically presenting spread materials into the cutting machine.

- {{tableWidthMm}} table width
- Modular design
- Digitally controlled speed drive
- Manual/Auto bypass switch
- Auto synchronised with Pathfinder cutter

blocks.title: Punchline P-180/P-220
blocks.body:
Automatic paper perforating machine. Designed for use by manufacturers utilising automatic knife cutting technology. Perforated paper is often required as an underlay, maximising vacuum and transfer of spread materials.

Paper width: {{paperWidthMm}} (Max)

blocks.title: Pathfinder Remote Support Program (RSP)
blocks.body:
## Pathfinder Remote Support Program (RSP)

**Low Cost • Free Software Upgrades • Free Technical Support • Discounted Parts**

RSP was created to provide support at an affordable cost with features that give immediate benefits. Pathfinder also wanted to reward our customers who remain on the program. The immediate benefits include access to our factory support team by phone and email including machine diagnostic remedy via direct internet connection.

RSP customers have priority over "On Call" customers while "Full Support Contract" customers have priority over "RSP" customers.

### RSP Details

**Consumable & Spare part sales:**
10% discount for all consumables and spare parts.

**Software updates:**
Free PathCut™ & PathWorks™ software updates covered when the customer commits to two (2) consecutive years in the program. Available in 2nd consecutive year on the program.

**Support:**
Phone support, composing and responding to emails, internal problem solving and remote login where available are included in the program. Remote internet access to customer's machines required for remote diagnostics. Remote access enables software upgrades and eliminates onsite service costs where remote access can resolve the issue.

**Parts Return:**
Refer to Pathfinder's Parts Return Policy.

**Requesting Support:**
Support requests should be made directly with the Pathfinder office. Urgent requests should be followed up with a phone call.

- Email: support@pathfindercut.com
- Phone: Contact Pathfinder AEST 8:30am - 5:00pm Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

**Payment:**
12 months in advance.

**Renewal:**
Renewal shall be automatic unless notification is given as per 8 a).

**Cancellation:**
Customer may cancel at any time 30 days prior to date of expiry. Email to: support@pathfindercut.com or registered post. Cancellations prior to fulfilment of 2 consecutive years RSP will incur cost of any software upgrades received within this period (refer to section 3).

Pathfinder reserves the right to cancel RSP at any time and refund customer remaining 'unused' portion calculated pro-rata from date of notification.

**Multiple products:**
Where a customer has multiple of the same Pathfinder product, RSP (Remote Support Program) is not available for a single product.

Example: Customer with 2 x M-series cutting machines — RSP is not available for only one M-series cutter. Both M-series cutters will need to be covered under the program.

**Pricing:**
Labour and travel hourly rates are subject to change in accordance with Pathfinder's pricing policy. RSP pricing may be subject to change in accordance with CPI increases.

Additional machines which are purchased will automatically join the RSP at additional cost.
